info.title: Meziantou.DocumentationGenerator
info.description: Generate a fully static documentation site from NuGet packages and Markdown pages.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the configuration file. Default: docgen.json if it exists; otherwise use command-line configuration.

options.name: --offline
options.description: Use only cached packages and never contact package sources.

options.name: --no-source-links
options.description: Do not generate links to source files.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Output verbosity: quiet, minimal, normal or detailed. [default: Normal]

options.name: --watch
options.description: Rebuild the site when the configuration, content or local packages change. Stop with Ctrl+C.

options.name: --serve
options.description: Serve the site on a local web server to preview it. With --watch, open pages reload after each build. Stop with Ctrl+C.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port of the preview web server. Use 0 to pick a free port. [default: 8080]

options.name: --schema
options.description: Overrides '$schema'. JSON schema used by editors.

options.name: --version
options.description: Overrides 'version'. Version of the configuration format. Must be 1.

options.name: --site-title
options.description: Overrides 'site.title'. Site title. Default: Documentation.

options.name: --site-description
options.description: Overrides 'site.description'. Site description used in metadata.

options.name: --site-home-title
options.description: Overrides 'site.homeTitle'. Title of the home page entry, listed first in the sidebar. Without an authored index.md, the generated home page is only listed when this is set. With an index.md, it replaces the page title in the sidebar.

options.name: --site-language
options.description: Overrides 'site.language'. Language of the content (BCP 47). Default: en.

options.name: --site-base-path
options.description: Overrides 'site.basePath'. URL path where the site is deployed, such as / or /docs/. Default: /.

options.name: --site-url
options.description: Overrides 'site.url'. Absolute origin of the site, such as https://example.com, used for canonical URLs and the sitemap. Must not contain a path; use basePath instead.

options.name: --site-logo
options.description: Overrides 'site.logo'. Logo image file, relative to the configuration file.

options.name: --site-favicon
options.description: Overrides 'site.favicon'. Favicon file, relative to the configuration file.

options.name: --site-social-image
options.description: Overrides 'site.socialImage'. Image used for social previews, relative to the configuration file. Requires url.

options.name: --site-robots
options.description: Overrides 'site.robots'. robots policy: none (no robots.txt), allow, or disallow. Default: none.

options.name: --site-footer
options.description: Overrides 'site.footer'. Footer displayed on every page, as inline Markdown: emphasis, code and links to absolute http or https URLs. Raw HTML is displayed as text.

options.name: --site-header-links
options.description: Overrides 'site.headerLinks'. Links displayed on the right side of the header. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --site-minify-html
options.description: Overrides 'site.minifyHtml'. Minify the generated HTML pages. Pages are about 10% smaller, but the build is slower. Default: false. Omit the value for true, or pass true or false explicitly.

options.name: --output
options.description: Overrides 'output'. Output directory, relative to the configuration file. Default: _site. On the command line, relative paths are resolved against the current directory.

options.name: --cache-directory
options.description: Overrides 'cacheDirectory'. Package cache directory, relative to the configuration file. Default: a per-user cache directory, or the DOCGEN_CACHE environment variable.

options.name: --packages
options.description: Overrides 'packages'. NuGet packages whose APIs are documented. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --references
options.description: Overrides 'references'. Packages whose metadata and XML documentation are used for inherited documentation and cross-references, without publishing their APIs. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --content-root
options.description: Overrides 'content.root'. Directory containing the Markdown pages, relative to the configuration file.

options.name: --content-assets
options.description: Overrides 'content.assets'. Additional files or directories copied as-is, relative to the content root. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --content-exclude
options.description: Overrides 'content.exclude'. Glob patterns of Markdown files to ignore, relative to the content root. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --content-edit-url
options.description: Overrides 'content.editUrl'. URL of the editor of a page, containing {path}: the path of the Markdown file relative to the content root (https://github.com/contoso/docs/edit/main/docs/{path}). Default: no edit link.

options.name: --api-include
options.description: Overrides 'api.include'. Patterns of namespaces or types to document. Default: all visible APIs. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --api-exclude
options.description: Overrides 'api.exclude'. Patterns of namespaces, types or members to exclude. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --xrefs
options.description: Overrides 'xrefs'. Links to documentation of symbols that are not part of the configured packages. Default: System and Microsoft namespaces link to Microsoft Learn. An empty list disables external links. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --diagnostics-allow-invalid-cref
options.description: Overrides 'diagnostics.allowInvalidCref'. Report unresolved or ambiguous cref links as warnings instead of errors. The link text is still rendered without a link. Default: false. Omit the value for true, or pass true or false explicitly.

options.name: --warnaserror
options.description: Overrides 'diagnostics.warningsAsErrors'. Treat warnings as errors. Omit the value for true, or pass true or false explicitly.

options.name: --diagnostics-severity
options.description: Overrides 'diagnostics.severity'. Severity overrides: code to error, warning, info or none. Pass a JSON object; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --source-links-enabled
options.description: Overrides 'sourceLinks.enabled'. Generate links to source files using PDBs and Source Link. Default: true. Omit the value for true, or pass true or false explicitly.

options.name: --source-links-symbol-servers
options.description: Overrides 'sourceLinks.symbolServers'. Symbol servers (SSQP, such as https://symbols.nuget.org/download/symbols) queried for PDBs that are not in the package. Default: none. Pass a JSON array; replaces the configured collection.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a docgen.json configuration file and a minimal content directory.

options.name: --package
options.description: Identifier of a package to document.

options.name: --package-version
options.description: Version or version range of the package. Default: the latest stable version.

options.name: --title
options.description: Site title.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing docgen.json. Existing Markdown files are never overwritten.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: directory
arguments.description: Directory where docgen.json is created. Default: the current directory.
